clusters.headline: Four Killed And UN Building Damaged In Khartoum Drone Strikes
aiSummaryBullets: Drone attacks in the Sudanese capital of Khartoum resulted in four confirmed deaths.
The strikes caused physical damage to a local United Nations building.

clusters.headline: South Sudan Delays Inaugural National Elections To February 2027
aiSummaryBullets: The government of South Sudan has rescheduled its first-ever national election to February 2027.
The postponement follows ongoing violent flare-ups that have impacted the stability required for a national vote.
